customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as literals inside workflows and composite actions (promtool, yq, gitleaks, actionlint, kubeconform, shellcheck, bats, vercel). The github-actions manager only sees `uses:` refs and container images — a version baked into a download URL or a workflow input default is invisible to it, so it silently rots.

Docker image pinned by tag AND digest in a workflow input default (perf-sitespeed.yml). The generic manager above requires a numeric default, which an image reference is not; this one keeps tag and digest moving together.

prek hook revs (prek.toml) — inline renovate comments (datasource=github-tags). No manager understands prek/pre-commit TOML, so without this the hook pins only move when someone remembers to run `prek autoupdate`.

packageRules.description: Self-references (`KevinDeBenedetti/github-workflows/...`) are this very repo — the internal composite-action refs are bumped by release-please (x-release-please-version), never by Renovate.

These versions are stored WITHOUT the leading v (the download URL adds it back), while the upstream tags carry it — strip it so comparisons work. Scoped to .github/: prek.toml pins rhysd/actionlint WITH the v.

actionlint >= 1.7.12 ships stale metadata for actions/create-github-app-token@v3 (false positives on `client-id`): callers of the actionlint action that do not pass `-ignore create-github-app-token` would break. Bumps need a deliberate approval from the dependency dashboard.
promtool and yq are installed by the same step in ci-prometheus.yml — one PR, one review.
